[SWS_PHM_01114] Folder structure for Supervised Entity files
⌈
This
requirement has been removed.
⌋

[SWS_PHM_01114] Folder structure for Health Channel files
⌈
The
generated header files defined by [SWS_PHM_01002] shall be located within the
folder:
<folder>/ara/phm/health_channels/<namespace[0]>/.../<namespace[n]>/
where:
<folder> is the start folder for the ara::phm header files specific for a project or
platform vendor,
<namespace[0]> ... <namespace[n]> are the namespace names as defined in
[SWS_PHM_01113].
⌋
